subject: SIG Questionnaire — submission timeline & doc-owner matrix
messages:
From: Elsa Perez <elsa.perez@northward.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Northward Procurement <procurement@northward.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG questionnaire request — target submission by July 5

Karthik,

Thanks for taking the time last week. As discussed, Northward is collecting SIG questionnaires and supporting artifacts for vendor review. Would Redwood be able to provide the completed SIG questionnaire plus supporting documentation (attestations, control excerpts, and the doc-owner matrix) by July 5?

A few notes on scope:
- We only need vendor-level answers, not per-product variants.
- Please highlight any third-party subprocessors and corresponding attestations.
- If you can provide a quick doc that maps each SIG section to a named owner inside Redwood that would be ideal.

If that timeline doesn't work, propose an alternative and we'll see if procurement can push the review window. Happy to jump on a short call if that helps.

Best,
Elsa Perez
Director, Vendor Risk Management
Northward Financial

Attachment: Northward_SIG_Request_20270624.pdf (application/pdf)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elsa Perez <elsa.perez@northward.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire request — target submission by July 5

Hi Elsa —

Thanks for the clear scope. July 5 is tight but achievable if we scope the first deliverable to an initial completed questionnaire (SIG spreadsheet) plus a targeted packet: SOC 2 extract, doc-owner matrix, and a list of subprocessors with links to attestations. We'll follow-up with a fuller artifact bundle in a staged delivery if required.

Proposed plan:
1) By EOD July 2: internal owners assigned, draft SIG answers (v1) uploaded to a shared Drive folder.
2) By July 5: submit SIG_Answers_v1.xlsx + SOC2-Attestation-Extract.pdf + doc-owner matrix (simple CSV/tab layout).
3) Post-submission (by July 12): provide any deeper artifacts requested (logs, config snippets) under NDA/secure transfer.

I'll assign owners now and loop you in on the Drive. If procurement needs formal attestation letters or signed addenda, flag that ASAP.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Security & Risk Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_Acknowledgement_Short.pdf (application/pdf)

Subject: Internal: SIG packet — owners and sprint plan (action required)

Team —

Per Northward's request, we need a focused SIG submission by July 5. I broke out owners and a lightweight deliverable plan below. Please confirm ownership and ETA in-line.

Doc-owner matrix (proposed):
- SIG Section A (Governance & Policy): monica_patel — due 2027-07-01 17:00 PT
- SIG Section B (Access Control): ben_carter — due 2027-07-01 17:00 PT
- SIG Section C (Data Protection & Encryption): laura_bennett — due 2027-07-01 17:00 PT
- Subprocessors & Attestations: karthik_iyer — collate by 2027-07-02 12:00 PT

Deliverables we will submit on July 5 (v1):
- SIG_Answers_v1.xlsx (complete spreadsheet with owners' answers)
- SOC2-Attestation-Extract.pdf (page excerpts with control mappings)
- doc-owner-matrix.csv (simple mapping: SIG section -> owner -> contact)
- short readme.txt with notes & known gaps

Please reply with any blocking issues. If you need extracts from production (logs, configuration screenshots) let me know immediately — we may need to sanitize or route via secure transfer.

Thanks,
Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Director, Security & Risk Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Elsa Perez <elsa.perez@northward.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Northward Procurement <procurement@northward.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 08:54:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire request — target submission by July 5

Karthik —

Appreciate the plan. A couple of clarifications from our InfoSec intake team after reviewing the scope: 
1) For Section C (Data Protection) we're specifically looking for the encryption-at-rest key management control excerpt and whether HSM/KMS is customer-managed or Redwood-managed.
2) For Subprocessors we need the contract status (PO signed / MSA / informal) for any subprocessors that handle customer content.
3) Please include the specific SOC 2 report date and auditor name on the cover of the attestation extract.

We've created a Northward intake folder and uploaded a short template for the doc-owner matrix. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-example-folder

If you run into anything that blocks your July 5 drop, tell procurement now so we can consider a short extension.

Regards,
Elsa Perez
Director, Vendor Risk Management
Northward Financial

Attachment: Northward_doc-owner-template.csv (text/csv)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elsa Perez <elsa.perez@northward.com>, Northward Procurement <procurement@northward.com>

Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2027 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire request — submission (v1) and artifact locations

Elsa —

Attached is our v1 package for Northward's SIG intake: SIG_Answers_v1.xlsx, SOC2-Attestation-Extract.pdf, and contract-redlines.docx (where we note subprocessors and contract posture).

Summary of key points per your clarifications:
- Key management: Redwood uses cloud-KMS with customer-managed key (CMK) option for Private deployments; default hosted offering uses Redwood-managed KMS with audited access controls. Extract included (SOC2-Attestation-Extract.pdf, pages 3-4).
- SOC 2: Most recent Type II report covering 2026-07-01 to 2027-06-30; auditor: Harper & Finch LLP (printed on attestation cover).
- Subprocessors: spreadsheet tab 'Subprocessors' lists vendor, function, contract status (PO/MSA/informal) and link to attestation where available.

Artifact locations:
- Shared Drive (read-only link): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-example-folder
- HubSpot record (for procurement trace): https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/record/NW-2027-042

Next steps:
- If Northward needs signed attestation letters, procurement/legal will need to sign an addendum.
- Ben: please queue any production logs or redaction work as a secure request item (I marked this in the Drive).
- Monica: update doc-owner-matrix.csv in the Drive with final contacts if any changes.

Happy to hop on a 20-minute call if you want to walk through the packet.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Security & Risk Operations
Redwood Inference
